notes: «- يعني ابن عبد الرحمن -» is an editor gloss and is left out
«أنه نظر إلى عبد الله بن عمر كيف يحكي رسول الله» names Ibn Umar as the source of the demonstrated saying he performs (rule 5 «نظر إلى X»); he is the last link
the Prophet's saying is what Ibn Umar demonstrates; the Prophet is not a link
